_comment: Per-phase model routing. Follows the skill's own spine. The standard itself lives in scaffold-ci and is read at audit time, so evaluate is comparison against a supplied contract rather than recall - which is what keeps it off frontier. See model-registry/references/routing-schema.md.

phases.why: Resolves the in-scope repositories and each one's mainline branch by named command. The one discipline is that an unresolvable remote HEAD makes trigger and ref-gating findings unverifiable rather than defaulting to main.

adjust.why: A long sweep has to carry a per-repository sequence across the whole run, and the characteristic failure is silently dropping repositories from the tail rather than getting any single one wrong.

phases.why: Runs the workflow inventory script and reads each artefact by literal path. The paths are specified precisely because a ** glob skips the dotted .github directory and a .yaml-suffixed repository then reads as having no CI at all - an absence produced by the tool, not the repository.

Compares each inventoried workflow against scaffold-ci's control surfaces, workflow contract and shipped assets, read at audit time. The core principle is to measure against that standard and never improvise a best practice, so the judgement is whether a difference is a gap, deliberate drift, or a non-house extra - and every inventoried workflow needs its own evidence row.

Scores each Docker-building or heavy-compute job for a runner move. This is the skill's headline lens and the recommendation carries real cost either way, but it is scored against documented criteria rather than reasoned from scratch.
Renders per-repository findings, and on a sweep a cross-repository consistency matrix. The single-repository case is transcription of decided findings.

adjust.why: The consistency matrix is the one output no per-repository pass produces: it has to see every repository at once to tell a house-wide gap from one repository's local choice, and that is the finding a reader acts on estate-wide.
